Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Mid-Century Wishbone Dining Chair, 22.4"W, White / Natural
Colors: White
Materials: stone
This dining chair combines Mid-Century modern and Scandinavian-inspired styles for beautiful form, functionality and comfort. With a woven rattan seat, solid beech wood frame and partially open-back this piece works for the dining room or anywhere you need extra seating. 22.4"W x 22.8"D x 28.75"H. Seat height: 18" Solid beech wood frame with a woven paper rattan seat This versatile, transitional chair blends well with traditional and modern styles. Arrives fully assembled Avoid moisture. Wipe away dust and debris with a soft, dry cloth Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
